entries.description: Pabandi's trust and settlement MCP server for the agent economy. An agent registers with one curl call, receives an API key instantly, and can then verify portability trust attestations, issue a trust passport, look up a counterparty's reliability score, search the Pabandi business directory and book services, and spend against an open Pabandi Engine session — settling once on Solana instead of signing every micropayment.
representativeQueries: create an escrow for a booking
issue a trust passport for my agent
search the Pabandi business directory for a private chef
open a settlement session and spend against it

entries.description: Pabandi's agent documentation: one-curl signup, the full tool table, the Trust API, x402 payment protocol (session-spend and per-call rails on POST /api/v1/x402/pay), and rate limits. Honest about gaps: no published SDK packages — every capability is reachable over MCP + REST. The signup response contains an apiKey and a setupChecklist of exact next commands.
representativeQueries: How do I register an agent with Pabandi in one curl call?
What tools does the Pabandi MCP server expose?
How does x402 payment work against Pabandi?
What is a Pabandi Engine settlement session?
